# Support

[Documentation](../docs/README.md) · [Project](../README.md)

AETHER OFFICE is pre-release software maintained in spare time. There is no paid support tier and no service-level
agreement.

## Where to ask

Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/haotool/aether-office/issues) with the issue templates. Search existing issues
before opening a new one. GitHub Discussions is not enabled for this repository.

Good reports include the version or commit, your platform, exact steps to reproduce and what you expected. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#reporting-bugs-and-proposing-features).

## What we do not support

- Running AETHER OFFICE as a hosted or multi-tenant service for others
- Provider CLI versions outside the [compatibility matrix](../docs/provider-compatibility.md)
- Recovering lost local data (sessions, databases under `.data/`); back up before upgrading
- Custom integrations, forks or deployments beyond what the documentation describes

Feature requests are welcome, but there is no roadmap commitment until a maintainer accepts the work.

## Security issues

Do **not** open a public issue for vulnerabilities. Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for private reporting.

## Code of conduct

Participation is governed by [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
